evidence.title: Shipper Club | A Club for Modern Builders With Taste
What Members Are Building | Shipper Club

name: Shipper Club
summary: Paid private community where builders share work, meet weekly and get resources to ship faster.
description: A private club for developers and founders, paid once ($149): a Discord community, weekly member meetings and live video calls, a curated builder resource list, a newsletter and exclusive member discounts. A public showcase and world map show what members are building and where they are.
contains: $149 one-time payment, no subscription; 242 members so far, batch 3 of 10
perks: private Discord, weekly meetings and calls, newsletter, builder resource list, member discounts
showcase of member builds with live products and GitHub star counts
world map of where members build from
